Subject: Discovery follow-up: coordinating demo + rotating time slots

Hi Oliver / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today  great conversation. Quick recap from our side:
- Primary use case: near-real-time scoring of analytics insights + embeddings for search reranking.
- Key constraints: sub-200ms P95 on critical routes, strict SOC 2 requirements, and a budget target around $X/token.
- Success metrics: reduce latency by 40% vs current infra while staying within the cost target; pilot with 2 product teams.

Next step: technical deep dive + demo (60 min) where we can bring an engineer and show a short hands-on run with a sample dataset. To make scheduling straightforward across your US / EMEA / APAC stakeholders, I suggest we adopt a rotating slot cadence so folks in each region get a reasonable meeting time every other week. Example pattern (all slots are 60-minute deep dives):

Option A  Rotation proposal (bi-weekly rotation):
- Week 1 (US-friendly): Tue Mar 16, 9:00am PT / 12:00pm ET / 17:00 GMT
- Week 2 (EMEA-friendly): Tue Mar 23, 4:00pm CET / 7:00am PT / 11:00pm SGT
- Week 3 (APAC-friendly): Tue Mar 30, 9:00am SGT / 2:00am PT / 5:00am ET (we'd record and share)

If that feels heavy, we can do a two-week rotation that alternates US / EMEA-friendly slots and then add an asynchronous recording + Q&A for APAC.

Please let me know: 1) which rotation approach you prefer (bi-weekly 3-way vs two-week alternating), 2) the primary attendees we should include for the deep dive (SE, infra, product), and 3) any blackout dates over the next three weeks.

I've attached a short demo agenda and a sample runbook (attachment). If easier, here's my scheduling link: https://cal.com/camila/redwood-demo  feel free to pick a slot and I will add Marissa (AE) + Aditya (Solutions) for the technical portion.

Best,

Camila Reyes
